changes: Voice conversations now learn when a background agent finishes, so Omi can mention the result and answer follow-up questions about it
Improved conversation navigation reliability when switching between memory and conversation views
Improved the reliability of macOS Beta qualification on the dedicated M1 Studio
Improved Memory with full-width conversations, a single navigation menu, consistent search, and tighter chat spacing

Added privacy-safe analytics for the memory assistant and transcript memory extraction (activation, analysis outcomes, and recording-to-memory success) so their reliability and funnel can be measured; no screen content, memory text, or identifiers are sent
Refined the top navigation with a tighter pill group and Omi-style Memory menu, narrowed Memories and Conversations for easier reading, and kept copy actions focused on code blocks
Fixed a failure-diagnostics change that prevented new desktop builds from being produced
Improved crash-report context when Rewind storage or the AI bridge fails to start
Fixed chat showing web-search activity for unrelated long prompts and restored live lookup routing for recent news and newly released products
